chapter.li: LEChapter10 Verse1 And now I, Jacob, speak unto 2PP you again, my beloved brethren, concerning this righteous branch of which I have spoken. VerseEnd Verse2 For behold, the promises which we have obtained are promises unto us according to the flesh. Wherefore, as it has been shewn unto me that many of our children shall perish in the flesh because of unbelief, nevertheless, God will be merciful unto many; and our children shall be restored, that they may come to that which will give them the true knowledge of their Redeemer. VerseEnd Verse3 Wherefore, as I said unto 2PP you, it must needs be expedient that Christ (for, in the last night, the angel spake unto me that this should be his name), that he should come among the Jews, among those who are the more wicked part of the world. And they shall crucify him — for it behooveth our God — and there is none other nation on earth that would crucify their God. VerseEnd Verse4 For should the mighty miracles be wrought among other nations, they would repent and know that he be their God. VerseEnd Verse5 But because of priestcrafts and iniquities, they at Jerusalem will stiffen their necks against him, that he be crucified. VerseEnd Verse6 Wherefore, because of their iniquities, destructions, famines, pestilences, and bloodsheds shall come upon them; and they who shall not be destroyed shall be scattered among all nations. VerseEnd

Verse7 But behold, thus saith the Lord God: When the day cometh that they shall believe in me, that I am Christ, then have I covenanted with their fathers that they shall be restored in the flesh upon the earth unto the lands of their inheritance. VerseEnd Verse8 And it shall come to pass that they shall be gathered in from their long dispersion, from the isles of the sea, and from the four parts of the earth. And the nations of the gentiles shall be great in the eyes of me, saith God, in carrying them forth to the lands of their inheritance. VerseEnd Verse9 Yea, the kings of the gentiles shall be nursing fathers unto them, and their queens shall become nursing mothers. Wherefore, the promises of the Lord are great unto the gentiles, for he hath spoken it, and who can dispute? VerseEnd Verse10 But behold, this land, saith God, shall be a land of 2PSI thine inheritance, and the gentiles shall be blessed upon the land. VerseEnd Verse11 And this land shall be a land of liberty unto the gentiles, and there shall be no kings upon the land who shall raise up unto the gentiles, VerseEnd Verse12 and I will fortify this land against all other nations. VerseEnd Verse13 And he that fighteth against Zion shall perish, saith God, VerseEnd Verse14 for he that raiseth up a king against me shall perish. For I the Lord, the King of Heaven, will be their king, and I will be a light unto them for ever that hear my words. VerseEnd

Verse15 Wherefore, for this cause, that my covenants may be fulfilled which I have made unto the children of men, that I will do unto them while they are in the flesh, I must needs destroy the secret works of darkness, and of murders, and of abominations. VerseEnd Verse16 Wherefore, he that fighteth against Zion, both Jew and Gentile, both bond and free, both male and female, shall perish; for they are they who are the whore of all the earth. For they who are not for me are against me, saith our God. VerseEnd Verse17 For I will fulfill my promises which I have made unto the children of men that I will do unto them while they are in the flesh. VerseEnd

Verse18 Wherefore, my beloved brethren, thus saith our God: I will afflict 2PSI thy seed by the hand of the gentiles; nevertheless, I will soften the hearts of the gentiles, that they shall be like unto a father to them. Wherefore, the gentiles shall be blessed and numbered among the house of Israel. VerseEnd Verse19 Wherefore, I will consecrate this land unto 2PSI thy seed, and they who shall be numbered among 2PSI thy seed, for ever, for the land of their inheritance; for it is a choice land, saith God unto me, above all other lands. Wherefore, I will have all men that dwell thereon that they shall worship me, saith God. VerseEnd

Verse20 And now my beloved brethren, seeing that our merciful God has given us so great knowledge concerning these things, let us remember him, and lay aside our sins, and not hang down our heads; for we are not cast off. Nevertheless, we have been driven out of the land of our inheritance, but we have been led to a better land, for the Lord has made the sea our path, and we are upon an isle of the sea. VerseEnd Verse21 But great are the promises of the Lord unto those who are upon the isles of the sea. Wherefore, as it says isles, there must needs be more than this, and they are inhabited also by our brethren. VerseEnd Verse22 For behold, the Lord God has led away from time to time from the house of Israel, according to his will and pleasure. And now behold, the Lord remembereth all these who have been broken off; wherefore, he remembereth us also. VerseEnd Verse23 Therefore, cheer up 2PP your hearts and remember that 2PP ye are free to act for yourselves, to choose the way of everlasting death or the way of eternal life. VerseEnd Verse24 Wherefore, my beloved brethren, reconcile yourselves to the will of God, and not to the will of the Devil and the flesh. And remember after 2PP ye are reconciled unto God that it is only in and through the grace of God that 2PP ye are saved. VerseEnd Verse25 Wherefore, may God raise 2PP you from death by the power of the resurrection, and also from everlasting death by the power of the atonement, that 2PP ye may be received into the eternal kingdom of God, that 2PP ye may praise him through grace divine. Amen. VerseEnd
